accepted_decisions.summary: Adopt loop-first source target and kb/telemetry CodeWiki state target.
Treat compiler output/build as trace data.
Use Git as cold truth and Pi as foundation.
Retire legacy audit/checks/policy/validation/source roots through compatibility migration.

product_impact: Gated-agency story updated for telemetry/gate/Git model.
system_impact: Lexicon, system specs, components, and diagrams updated.

non_goals: No source migration or deletion in decision loop.
risks: High-risk structural migration requires staged planning and gates.
